deploy-party.SETTINGS.deployOnDrop.name: Deploy immediately on drop
deploy-party.SETTINGS.deployOnDrop.hint: When enabled, dragging a folder onto the canvas deploys every actor in it right away instead of creating a party marker to deploy later. Hold Shift while dropping to use the "Shift+Drop" marker behavior below instead of the usual one.
deploy-party.SETTINGS.shiftAfterDeployBe: Only applies when "Deploy immediately on drop" is on and you hold Shift while dropping the folder: overrides "After deploying, the party marker should" for that one drop.
When enabled, Deploy also drops actors found in nested subfolders, not just the folder that was dragged onto the canvas.
deploy-party.SETTINGS.afterDeployBehavio: After deploying, the party marker should
What happens to the party token itself once its members have been placed on the scene.
deploy-party.SETTINGS.deployLayout.name: Deploy layout
deploy-party.SETTINGS.deployLayout.hint: How deployed tokens are arranged around the party marker.
deploy-party.SETTINGS.tokenSpacing.name: Deploy spacing (grid squares)
deploy-party.SETTINGS.tokenSpacing.hint: Gap between deployed tokens, measured in grid squares. Lower values pack tokens tighter together.
deploy-party.SETTINGS.partyTokenSize.hin: Width and height of the party marker created when a folder is dropped onto the canvas.
Artwork used for newly created party markers. Pick any image from your file system or a compendium pack.
deploy-party.recall.confirmBody: Recall {count} token(s)? They will be deleted from the scene — any HP, conditions, or other changes tracked on an unlinked token will be lost.
deploy-party.notifications.gmOnly: Only the GM can do that.
deploy-party.notifications.folderMissing: The source folder for "{name}" no longer exists.
deploy-party.notifications.folderEmpty: The folder "{name}" has no actors to deploy.
deploy-party.notifications.markerEmptyFo: The folder "{name}" has no actors to deploy yet — add some (or enable subfolders) before deploying this marker.
deploy-party.notifications.nothingToReca: Nothing from this party is currently deployed.
deploy-party.notifications.markerGone: The party marker and its source folder are both gone; the deployed tokens were removed without a new marker.
